title: Göbekli Tepe: The Enigmatic Temple
hook: Why did ancient hunters build massive stone circles?
headline: The Stone Circle That Baffles Archaeologists

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1994, archaeologists uncovered towering T-shaped pillars at Göbekli Tepe.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Radiocarbon dating suggests the site was built around 9600 BCE, predating Stonehenge by 6,000 years.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Excavations revealed dozens of animal skulls, especially wild boar, arranged in ritualistic patterns.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A 2021 study found the pillars align with the rising sun on the summer solstice, suggesting astronomical purpose.

end.line: What hidden purpose might these stones truly serve?

description: Explore the baffling clues behind Göbekli Tepe's ancient stone circles.
